messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — planning to promote the staging scaling policy for gpu-slice-phi from v1.3 -> v1.4 tonight at 02:00 UTC. This is purely policy: lower min replicas for idle tenants, different burst cap. No model changes.

maria: +1, what's the expected impact on p99 latency?

jordan: Should be minimal for steady-state traffic. We lower minReplicas from 2 -> 1 for low-priority slices; burst cap still allows quick warmups. Expect slight bump for cold-starts on tiny bursts (100-200ms), but p99 for active reqs unchanged.

kevin: Who will execute the promotion? I can run the rollout if @priya is busy.

priya: I can trigger the deploy and monitor. Will hand off to kevin for rollback permissions.

jordan: Thanks — plan: 02:00 UTC promote via infra-playbook (single atomic config apply), smoke checks start at +5m, monitor for 20m, then mark done. If anything looks off we rollback to v1.3.

theo: Can you paste the exact config diff? Want to sanity-check the min/burst numbers.

jordan: Sure — snippet below (this is the policy blob):
```yaml
scalingPolicy:
  name: gpu-slice-phi
  version: v1.4
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 20
  burstCapacity: 6
  warmupSeconds: 8
  metric: rps
  fallbackTo: v1.3
```

maria: Looks reasonable. How are we handling tenants pinned to dedicated slices? They shouldn't be affected, right?

jordan: Correct — only the 'shared' phi slice gets new policy. Dedicated/customer-pinned pools are excluded by selector.

priya: Rollout steps for my runbook:
- prereq: confirm no active capacity ops (ping infra)
- run: `infra apply-policy --slice gpu-slice-phi --file policies/phi-v1.4.yaml`
- smoke: send 50 synthetic requests to edge endpoint, check latency and GPU utilization
- validate: ensure p50/p95 stable and error rate <0.1%
- finalize: update console tag + notify customers

kevin: If rollback needed, command is `infra rollback-policy --slice gpu-slice-phi --version v1.3`. I'll be standing by with permissions.

ops-alert: Deploy bot scheduled: policy-promo job queued for 1729461600 (02:00:00 UTC). Creator: priya.

maria: For smoke, can we add a KV-cache prefix hit check? If warmup causes repeated cache misses that's a red flag.

priya: Good call — I'll include `cache.hit_rate` in the checks. Threshold: >85% after 5m.

theo: Also confirm autoscaler logs for scale decisions — want to see at least one scale-up event during synthetic burst to verify burstCapacity works.

jordan: Agreed. Monitoring dashboard: /dashboards/gpu-slice-phi -> check `scale_events`, `gpu_util`, `latency_p95`, `cache.hit_rate`.

kevin: Safety net: if p95 increases >200ms or error rate >0.5% we rollback. If cache.hit_rate <70% after 10m we rollback.

priya: I'll post live updates in this thread during the run. If anyone wants pager duty, @kevin has rollback perms.

jordan: One more: please thumbs-up once you have your alert windows ready. :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:

ops-alert: Deploy bot: policy-promo job started (1729461600). Running preflight checks...

priya: preflight green: no active capacity ops, infra health OK, quotas fine. Starting apply now.

priya: applied policy v1.4 — waiting 60s for controllers to reconcile.

ops-alert: Event: policy apply acknowledged by controller (1729461705).

theo: Watching logs — saw first scale decision at +90s, GPU util spike to 65% during synthetic burst, p95 stayed ~120ms.

maria: cache.hit_rate 87% after 5m, error rate 0.02%. Looks good.

kevin: All checks within thresholds. No rollback. Stand down.

jordan: Great job team — I'll update the release notes and tag the policy in the catalog. Closing thread after final confirmation at +20m.

priya: Final confirm: stable for 20m, promoting done.

ops-alert: Deploy bot: job completed (1729463200).

jordan: Thanks everyone. If anything crops up overnight, ping this thread and we'll revert.
